title: Variable Master Catch
subtitle: Finish the catch challenge with multi-type Java variable declarations.
objective: Complete all Java Variables rounds by catching the right parts, avoiding hazards, and arranging each declaration correctly.

rounds.prompt: Build a valid String variable declaration for userName.
hints: String values use double quotation marks.
userName is the variable identifier, not the value.
Keep the declaration in the standard Java order.

rounds.prompt: Build a valid int variable declaration for attemptCount.
hints: Do not wrap the number in quotation marks.
The semicolon always ends the declaration.

rounds.prompt: Build a valid boolean variable declaration for debugMode.
hints: Boolean variables store either true or false.
debugMode is the name of the variable.
The value belongs after the equals sign.
